text: - Ruling: Keep the new operation receipt as a separate logical table because the existing SyncJob and ChangeLog cannot uniquely represent a read/preview/write operation chain. Cost if wrong: one migration and repository layer must be revised before MCP work.
decision_zh: 新增独立逻辑操作回执表，任务与变更日志无法唯一代表整条操作链。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改一份迁移和回执仓储层。

text: - Ruling: Preserve current SyncJob statuses and add Observation execution labels rather than renaming database states. Cost if wrong: MCP and evaluator contracts need a compatibility rewrite.
decision_zh: 保留 SyncJob 状态，新增 Observation 执行状态。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改 MCP 与评测契约的兼容映射。

text: - Ruling: Add an internal HTTP boundary before MCP implementation. Cost if wrong: MCP would need a different transport integration and tests would not exercise the production service boundary.
decision_zh: 先建立内部 HTTP 能力边界，再实现 MCP。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整 MCP 传输集成，补验真实生产服务边界。

text: Ruling: Split Task 4 into 4A (transaction-aware store/job entry points and asynchronous receipt finalization) and 4B (OrganizationCapabilities facade, runtime policy, integration) — current StoreAdminService.apply and SqlSyncJobRepository.submit/retry independently own their sessions, and Publisher owns the asynchronous commit, so the plan file list is insufficient for its binding atomicity and commit-version evidence constraints. Extend the allowed files minimally to stores/service.py, persistence/repositories.py, sync/publisher.py and focused tests; retain the current public/admin service signatures as transaction-owning wrappers. Cost if wrong: revise the internal Session entry points and async receipt integration before MCP, without changing external HTTP contracts.
decision_zh: 能力 Task 4 拆为事务/异步回执集成 4A 与 facade/策略 4B；最小扩展门店、任务、Publisher 文件，原公开服务入口保留。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改内部 Session 入口与异步回执集成，不变更外部 HTTP 契约。

text: Ruling: A production confirmation is accepted only through trusted AgentContext.approved until an explicit token verifier is implemented; an arbitrary model-supplied approval_token never authorizes a write — the approved design and MCP plan explicitly disallow treating a token-shaped string as confirmation. Cost if wrong: adjust the trusted approval adapter, preserving the denied-by-default business boundary.
decision_zh: 生产写批准只接受可信 AgentContext.approved；模型传入 approval_token 不构成批准。
reversal_cost_zh: 替换可信批准适配器，保持默认拒绝。

text: Ruling: Task 4B may add an explicit keyword-only internal result classification (write_operation, default preserving existing guards) to CapabilityResult, omitted from serialized output — current Task 1 validation treats every submitted observation as a write, which cannot express a successful read with operation_id=None without incorrectly emitting evaluator-only verified. Read results may state completed request execution with no write receipt; actual writes still require operation_id. Cost if wrong: revise the internal constructor classification; the fixed four-field wire contract remains unchanged.
decision_zh: CapabilityResult 内部增加不序列化的 write_operation，区分完成读取与真实写入。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整内部构造分类，不变更固定 wire 字段。

text: Task 4A: implementation dispatch base 9870932; brief task-4a-brief.md; original Task 4 split ruling above applies.
decision_zh: 既有裁决的程序性索引或引用；不新增独立决策。
reversal_cost_zh: 无新增撤回成本；成本随被引用的实际裁决。

text: Ruling: Extend Task 4A minimally to sync/worker.py::_fail_job — actual Worker exhaustion writes SyncJob.failed directly rather than using SqlSyncJobRepository.mark_failed, so repository-only integration would leave real failure receipts accepted. Use WorkerLease→DatasetState→job→receipt locks and finalize only terminal failed, retaining queued backoff. Cost if wrong: revise this internal failure hook and lock-order tests; no external API or retry-policy change.
decision_zh: 真实 Worker 耗尽重试时终结失败回执；锁序为租约→数据状态→任务→回执，排队退避不终结。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改内部失败钩子及锁序测试，不改重试策略。

text: Task 4A: implementer /root/transaction_receipt_integration; report task-4a-report.md; worker scope ruling and StoreApplyResult interface recorded in task-4a/task-4b briefs.
decision_zh: 既有裁决的程序性索引或引用；不新增独立决策。
reversal_cost_zh: 无新增撤回成本；成本随被引用的实际裁决。

text: Ruling: Allow Task 4A fix round 1 to introduce the planned Task 6 integration file test_capability_mysql.py early for the named RR two-transaction regression — this tests the newly exposed caller-transaction guarantee directly; SQLite cannot establish InnoDB Read View behavior. Task 6 extends the file instead of recreating it. Cost if wrong: move the focused integration test into Task 6; no production contract changes.
decision_zh: 提前增加真实 MySQL 双事务回归，验证 RR Read View；后续 Task 6 扩展同一文件。
reversal_cost_zh: 移动测试归属，不改生产契约。

text: Ruling: New Agent store-apply calls must bind expected_epoch as well as expected_version (keyword-only extension, preserving the planned first five arguments) — a restored dataset can reuse the same integer version, so version alone cannot prove that the preview belongs to the current dataset. Require the epoch on this new capability/internal/MCP contract; existing admin/public HTTP envelopes are outside this change. Cost if wrong: revise the new Agent input schema and tests before rollout; no existing client contract is removed.
decision_zh: Agent 门店 apply 同时绑定 expected_epoch 与 expected_version，避免恢复后版本号重用。
reversal_cost_zh: 上线前调整新增输入 schema 与测试，不移除现有客户端契约。

text: Ruling: Add an L0 get_operation capability and later HTTP/MCP lookup by operation_id or the caller-scoped idempotency_key — a lost write response can lose the server-generated operation_id, and the approved rule requires observation before another write. This fills the observation path without re-submitting a mutation; queries are constrained to trusted actor_id/environment. Cost if wrong: adjust one new read schema/endpoint/tool; persisted receipts and existing capabilities stay compatible.
decision_zh: 新增 L0 get_operation，按 operation_id 或主体范围内幂等键观察丢失响应，禁止以重写代替查询。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整一个新增读取 schema、端点与工具，回执保持兼容。

text: Task 4B: implementation dispatch base 1e06eb1; brief task-4b-brief.md contains controller rulings and formal interfaces from task-4a-report.md.
decision_zh: 既有裁决的程序性索引或引用；不新增独立决策。
reversal_cost_zh: 无新增撤回成本；成本随被引用的实际裁决。

text: Ruling: Capture failed job audit_ids in the original terminal transaction (minimal ReceiptRepository extension) instead of lazily fetching all later job logs — retries reuse job_id and would otherwise contaminate the historical failure evidence. Cost if wrong: adjust the internal failure-summary helper and compatibility tests; no new schema or public API change.
decision_zh: 失败任务的 audit_ids 在原终态事务冻结，避免同 job 重试污染历史证据。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整失败摘要辅助方法和兼容测试，不增加结构。

text: Ruling: Task 6 must explicitly set the new operation_receipt table collation to utf8mb4_0900_as_cs in ORM and revision 0007, preserving all SOURCE_ID utf8mb4_bin columns, and make new MySQL connection settings explicit/observable — both production and test Compose prescribe utf8mb4_0900_as_cs, while the new table currently relies on server defaults, contrary to AGENTS.md. Do not alter any existing table collation or execute production migrations; provide preflight/verification/rollback notes. Cost if wrong: revise only the new-table options and connection setup before rollout; existing column definitions and constraints stay unchanged.
decision_zh: 新 operation_receipt 表显式使用 utf8mb4_0900_as_cs，来源 ID 保留 utf8mb4_bin；显式设置并验证 MySQL 会话配置。
reversal_cost_zh: 上线前修改新表选项与连接设置，不转换已有表或列。

text: Ruling: Try an official MySQL 8.4.11 portable Windows instance inside the ignored worktree runtime directory, bound only to 127.0.0.1 with a dedicated _test database and no Windows service installation — Docker is unavailable, but a disposable local process can exercise the same InnoDB/RR guarantees and avoid leaving real acceptance untested. Cost if wrong: stop/remove only this disposable runtime and retain the documented Compose acceptance path; no production database or system service is changed.
decision_zh: Docker 不可用时，在忽略目录运行官方 MySQL 8.4.11 便携实例，仅绑定回环，不安装系统服务。
reversal_cost_zh: 停止并移除该一次性运行环境，保留 Compose 验收路径。

text: Ruling: Include config.py in Task5's minimal allowed changes — its file list omits the file but Step3 explicitly requires agent_service_token: SecretStr | None, and fail-closed authentication depends on that setting. Cost if wrong: move only the token setting to the existing configuration boundary; no public HTTP or business schema changes.
decision_zh: 内部鉴权所需配置项 agent_service_token 纳入能力 Task 5 最小文件范围。
reversal_cost_zh: 移动该配置项至既有配置边界，不改公共 API 或业务结构。

text: Ruling: Extend Task6 minimally to SqlSyncJobRepository.submit_in_session and the capability request_sync call, adding an optional keyword-only trigger_source supplied as validated context.actor_type (human_agent/ci_agent), while keeping the complete actor_id in requested_by/receipt and preserving existing callers' default trigger-source behavior — real MySQL rejects valid long Agent IDs copied into VARCHAR32 trigger_source (DataError1406), so shortening test IDs would conceal a production failure. Do not alter the column or overwrite the original trigger when reusing/retrying a job. Cost if wrong: revise this internal source-classification argument and regression tests; existing API signatures/DDL and full actor audit remain intact.
decision_zh: 同步任务 trigger_source 使用经验证的 actor_type，完整 actor_id 保留在 requested_by/回执；重用或重试不覆盖原触发来源。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改内部可选参数与回归测试，保留字段长度和完整身份审计。

text: Ruling: Treat the three approved dependent plans as one branch delivery: keep every per-task spec/quality gate and run one most-capable whole-branch review after capability, MCP and Evaluation tasks are all complete, rather than re-reviewing the same cumulative branch three times — the broad review is meant to assess final cross-layer behavior, which is unavailable after the first subsystem alone. Retain each plan's separate workspace/ledger until that unified final gate, then collect all rulings before cleanup. Cost if wrong: add a subsystem-wide review before release; no task gate, implementation scope or final branch review is removed.
decision_zh: 三份依赖计划作为一次分支交付；逐任务双门禁保留，最后执行一次统一全分支评审，完成前不清理台账。
reversal_cost_zh: 发布前补一次子系统全审；不删除任务门禁或统一终审。

text: Ruling: Include backend/scripts/mysql_acceptance.py as Task6's repeatable acceptance entry — the task requires actual-target preflight, explicit connection/schema verification, migration/test commands and secret-free evidence; one small wrapper centralizes the validated _test URL and captures/redacts subprocess output instead of duplicating credential-handling snippets across docs. Cost if wrong: remove the wrapper and replace its documented invocations with equivalent reviewed commands; no production runtime behavior depends on it.
decision_zh: 增加 mysql_acceptance.py，集中实际目标预检、迁移/测试命令及子进程输出脱敏。
reversal_cost_zh: 移除包装器并改用等效且经审查的命令，生产运行不依赖它。

decision_zh: 既有裁决的程序性索引或引用；不新增独立决策。

text: - Ruling: Task1 creates server.py despite the omitted Files row, verifies real SDK initialize/discovery and CLI help/fail-closed skeleton, and defers fixed-tool discovery/live dependency wiring to Task4 — those consumers require Task2/3 implementations and actual Task4 registration; do not add placeholder business tools merely to pass an early name test. Cost if wrong: adjust the server scaffold and stage1/4 tests; final tool contract unchanged.
decision_zh: MCP Task 1 补 server.py，验证官方 SDK 初始化/发现与入口骨架；真实工具绑定待依赖完成后放到 Task 4。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整骨架和分阶段测试，最终工具契约不变。

text: - Ruling: The final catalog has 15 tools including L0 get_operation, and apply_store_changes requires expected_epoch plus expected_version — carries the already-approved capability observation and restore-safe version rulings through MCP. Cost if wrong: revise only the new MCP schema/catalog and client tests before rollout.
decision_zh: 最终目录包含 get_operation 共 15 工具；门店 apply 同时要求 epoch 与 version。
reversal_cost_zh: 上线前调整新增 MCP schema、目录和客户端测试。

text: - Ruling: Prefer the verified current official SDK mcp==2.2.0 with exact runtime/transitive pins and platform markers; use its real API rather than the plan's illustrative tool_names helper — current official release and Python metadata support project Python3.11+, while pre-existing httpx remains the internal HTTP client. If an actual dependency conflict appears, report evidence before selecting a maintenance SDK. Cost if wrong: switch the precise SDK pin and transport/confirmation integration, then rerun adapter compatibility tests.
decision_zh: 锁定官方 mcp==2.2.0 及传递依赖，使用真实 SDK API。
reversal_cost_zh: 更换精确 SDK 版本与传输/确认集成，重跑兼容测试。

text: - Ruling: Introduce a separate ORG_MCP_SERVICE_TOKEN (SecretStr) for inbound MCP access, retaining ORG_AGENT_SERVICE_TOKEN solely for trusted sidecar-to-capability requests — a model-facing MCP client must not receive the backend identity-assertion credential. Default both fail closed, do not inject DB/Feishu credentials into sidecar. Cost if wrong: revise the one extra credential/deployment setting, preserving least privilege.
decision_zh: 入站 MCP 使用独立 ORG_MCP_SERVICE_TOKEN，后端 ORG_AGENT_SERVICE_TOKEN 仅供可信 sidecar 声明身份；两者默认拒绝。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整新增凭据和部署配置，保持最小权限。

text: - Ruling: Bind AgentPrincipal to trusted server configuration/authenticated service identity; never take actor/environment/approved from tool arguments or arbitrary client headers. CI cases may construct a dedicated configured test server/principal per run/case. Cost if wrong: replace the principal resolver for a future multi-user identity provider; capability and tool contracts remain compatible.
decision_zh: AgentPrincipal 绑定可信服务配置/认证身份，不采信工具参数或任意客户端身份/批准头。
reversal_cost_zh: 未来替换多用户身份解析器，能力与工具契约保持兼容。

text: - Ruling: Production L2 confirmation uses official MCP elicitation/Resolve from the trusted host; accept only explicit accept with strict confirmed=true, deny decline/cancel/unsupported/timeout, and never expose confirmation as model-supplied tool input. CI test L2 uses its existing automatic policy; no static approved environment switch. Cost if wrong: replace the trusted confirmation adapter, retaining fail-closed policy and backend approved header.
decision_zh: 生产 L2 采用官方 elicitation/Resolve 可信确认，只有显式 accept 且 confirmed=true 可写；拒绝、取消、不支持、超时均拒写；测试 CI 自动策略独立。
reversal_cost_zh: 替换确认适配器，保留后端批准头和默认拒绝。

text: - Ruling: CapabilityHttpClient.call may accept a keyword-only trusted approved flag, default false, to forward the internal X-Agent-Approved header after policy/confirmation — the three original positional parameters cannot carry that trusted decision. Cost if wrong: revise the private client forwarding signature and its tests; wire tool arguments unchanged.
decision_zh: 内部 HTTP 客户端增加可信、仅限关键字的 approved 参数，默认 false。
reversal_cost_zh: 调整私有转发方法和测试，不改模型工具参数。

text: - Ruling: Deny every production ci_agent request, including reads — the approved isolation rule and existing capability reject production CI, so MCP must reject before contacting the backend as well. Cost if wrong: adjust only the pure policy/auth boundary if the human later authorizes production CI reads.
decision_zh: production 环境拒绝全部 ci_agent 请求，包括读取，且在接触后端前拒绝。
reversal_cost_zh: 仅在人明确授权生产 CI 读取后调整纯策略/认证边界。

text: - Ruling: Treat 5xx retryability as opt-in from the internal service rather than inferred from status — Task3 test wording conflicts with its explicit Step3 restriction, and unknown write outcome must not prompt an automatic resend. Cost if wrong: revise error metadata only, retaining observation-before-retry behavior.
decision_zh: 5xx 是否可重试由内部服务显式给出，不根据 HTTP 状态推断；结果未知先观察。
reversal_cost_zh: 只调整错误元数据，保留观察后再决定重试。

text: - Ruling: Enable the Compose MCP service through an explicit agent profile with selective environment variables — otherwise adding mandatory new token interpolation/full env_file would break existing deployments or expose unrelated DB/Feishu credentials. Cost if wrong: change only the sidecar activation command and network/env wiring; existing app startup remains compatible.
decision_zh: Compose MCP 由显式 agent profile 启用，选择性传递环境变量，避免破坏原部署或传入数据库/飞书秘密。
reversal_cost_zh: 修改 sidecar 启动命令、网络和变量接线。

text: Ruling: Constrain backend requires-python to >=3.11,<3.14 for this locked runtime, retaining existing FastAPI0.116.1/Starlette0.47.3 — SDK2.2.0 conditionally requires Starlette>=0.48 on Python3.14+, which conflicts with the approved existing stack; current deployed/tested Python3.13.14 is compatible. Document actual tested3.13 separately from metadata-compatible3.11–3.13. Cost if wrong: revise the Python upper bound or perform a separately reviewed framework/SDK upgrade; no unverified3.14 support is advertised.

reversal_cost_zh: 调整版本上限或另行评审框架/SDK 升级，不宣称未验证的 3.14。

text: Ruling: Extend Task3 minimally to backend/app/dependencies.py, focused internal-router tests and docs/backend-api.md to add optional X-Agent-Identity-Encoding: base64url-utf8 for actor_id/run_id/case_id — the reviewed Principal supports Chinese IDs but httpx ASCII and ASGI Latin-1 header handling otherwise corrupt valid trusted identity. With the marker present, encode every present identity ID as canonical unpadded base64url of UTF-8, decode strictly after service authentication, reject unknown/duplicate marker or malformed/noncanonical encoding, and retain existing unmarked ASCII clients. Actor-type/environment/approved remain literal trusted fields. Cost if wrong: revise this private optional identity transport encoding and paired tests before rollout; public APIs, stored identity and DB schema remain unchanged.
decision_zh: 可信内部身份头可标记 base64url-utf8 编码，以严格规范编码承载中文 actor/run/case ID；原 ASCII 调用兼容。
reversal_cost_zh: 上线前调整私有身份传输及成对测试，不改存储身份或数据库。

text: Ruling: Bring the already-planned exactly pinned safe YAML parser forward from Evaluation Task1 into MCP Task5 when adding Compose YAML tests, with minimal pyproject/requirements.lock changes — deployment contract tests must parse real YAML without depending on a running Docker daemon or a machine-specific Docker CLI, and the same parser is required immediately afterward by versioned evaluation cases. Verify official package metadata/version before pinning; Evaluation Task1 consumes the shared dependency instead of duplicating it. text: Ruling: In Task4 minimally correct read_completion to evaluate the last relevant target read response as completion evidence against fixed expectations and the final independent snapshot, instead of requiring every historical successful read to equal the final state; retain binding/uniqueness and pre-redaction leak checks across all responses — a legitimate read(v1) -> controlled write(v2) -> final read(v2) must not fail solely because its truthful earlier observation used v1, and hardcoding the smoke to avoid that read would conceal a real integration defect. A later target failure must not be hidden by choosing an earlier successful response. Earlier observations remain historical evidence rather than final postconditions. Include assertions.py and focused test_assertions.py in Task4 allowed changes and task-scoped review. Cost if wrong: revise evaluation-only completion selection and regression cases; production APIs, fixed models and database structure remain unchanged.
